rows.label: tlk70000012_10_msg0001
rows.name:
Morumo-san, the chairman, works hard
hard for the shopping district. I
trusted him a great deal, but...

rows.label: tlk70000012_10_msg0002
rows.name:
Whatever the circumstances, I'm truly
disappointed he was doing bad things
behind the scenes.

rows.label: tlk70000012_10_msg0003
rows.name:
After you corrected his mistake, he
reflected on it. Now he wants to make
this shopping district even bigger.

rows.label: tlk70000012_10_msg0004
rows.name:
Thanks to that, the whole shopping
district feels livelier somehow.

rows.label: tlk70000012_10_msg0005
rows.name:
Let me thank you again as well...
Thank you very much.

rows.label: tlk70000012_10_msg0006
rows.name:
All right, enough gloomy talk. Time to
get back to work!

rows.label: tlk70000012_10_msg0007
rows.name:
Next time, I can't lower the prices,
but I'll serve you with all the
sincerity I can!

rows.label: tlk70000012_10_msg0008
rows.name:
Yes, you'll always have a warm
welcome from me, and everyone
in Formide Shopping Street!
